title: Ek Raat Mein Khali Hue 84 Gaon 😨 | Kuldhara | Bhootiya Bharat Ep 2
setting: Kuldhara village near Jaisalmer, Thar desert, Rajasthan, India
description:
Kehte hain ek hi raat mein 84 gaon ke log sab kuch chhodkar chale gaye… aur jaate-jaate shraap de gaye.
Aaj tak Kuldhara mein koi nahi basa. Kyun?

#kuldhara #mystery #BhootiyaBharat

scenes.narration: कहा जाता है... एक ही रात में 84 गाँव ख़ाली हो गए। और कोई कभी लौटकर नहीं आया।
image_prompts: an abandoned sandstone desert village at dusk, rows of roofless houses, empty lanes, no people
a lonely broken doorway of a sandstone house with desert wind blowing sand through it
scenes.visual_description: an abandoned sandstone desert village at dusk, rows of roofless houses, empty lanes, no people

scenes.narration: ये है कुलधरा... जैसलमेर के पास, थार रेगिस्तान में बसा एक गाँव।
image_prompts: aerial view of a ruined sandstone village in the golden Thar desert with dunes around it
a dusty desert road leading to a ruined village gate under a hot sky
scenes.visual_description: aerial view of a ruined sandstone village in the golden Thar desert with dunes around it

scenes.narration: यहाँ पालीवाल ब्राह्मण रहते थे... अमीर, मेहनती, और खेती के उस्ताद।
image_prompts: a prosperous Rajasthani desert village centuries ago, villagers in white dhotis and colourful turbans and ghagras, wells and green fields
Rajasthani farmers drawing water from a stepwell, camels and clay pots, golden light
scenes.visual_description: a prosperous Rajasthani desert village centuries ago, villagers in white dhotis and colourful turbans and ghagras, wells and green fields

scenes.narration: कहते हैं, रियासत के दीवान सालिम सिंह की नज़र गाँव की एक लड़की पर पड़ गई।
image_prompts: a stern Rajasthani minister in royal attire and turban on horseback watching a village from a distance, ominous
a sinister royal palace of Jaisalmer at dusk, golden sandstone, dark clouds
scenes.visual_description: a stern Rajasthani minister in royal attire and turban on horseback watching a village from a distance, ominous

scenes.narration: उसने धमकी दी... शादी नहीं हुई, तो पूरे गाँव पर भारी टैक्स और ज़ुल्म होंगे।
image_prompts: frightened Rajasthani villagers gathered at night by oil lamps, elders talking in whispers
royal soldiers with spears standing at the edge of a desert village at night
scenes.visual_description: frightened Rajasthani villagers gathered at night by oil lamps, elders talking in whispers

scenes.narration: उसी रात सब चुपचाप चले गए... अपने घर, खेत, सब कुछ छोड़कर।
image_prompts: a long line of Rajasthani families with bullock carts and lanterns leaving a desert village silently at night
empty houses with doors left open and oil lamps still burning, nobody inside
scenes.visual_description: a long line of Rajasthani families with bullock carts and lanterns leaving a desert village silently at night

scenes.narration: और जाते-जाते श्राप दे गए... जो यहाँ बसेगा, वो बर्बाद हो जाएगा।
image_prompts: an old Rajasthani village elder raising his hand toward the dark sky casting a curse, lightning in the distance
ghostly mist rolling through the empty lanes of the abandoned village under moonlight
scenes.visual_description: an old Rajasthani village elder raising his hand toward the dark sky casting a curse, lightning in the distance

scenes.narration: इतिहासकार कहते हैं, असली वजह शायद पानी की कमी और भारी टैक्स थे।
image_prompts: a dried-up cracked village well in the desert with scorched earth around it
ancient ledger and coins on a wooden table, symbolising heavy taxes, candlelight
scenes.visual_description: a dried-up cracked village well in the desert with scorched earth around it

scenes.narration: पर सवाल आज भी है... इतने सारे लोग एक ही रात में कहाँ चले गए?
image_prompts: the ruined sandstone village silhouetted against a blood-red desert sunset, nobody there
a single empty lane of the ruins at dusk with wind blowing sand, eerie silence
